question: Does a North Sister route called West Face - Right exist, and what is it?
answer: It exists only as a bare Mountain Project listing on North Sister: grade string 4th / steep snow, no description, no FA. No guidebook, trip report or log fetched describes a distinct route by that name. A SummitPost log only mentions skirting down the west face past spires on a descent. The MP area named West Face, Right (id 106225684) is another place entirely (Medlicott Dome, Yosemite). The Bowling Alley finish is on the west side of the summit pyramid, so the stub likely duplicates or varies the South Ridge finish (inference, unconfirmed).
recommendation: Do not fill it. Owner choice: delete it as an unverifiable empty stub (preferred; same 4th grade as South Ridge) or leave it blank. All stored fields are null, so nothing is lost by deleting.
